fields.BULLETIN TYPE: Qualifying Transaction-Completed/New Symbol, Private Placement-Non-Brokered, Name Change and Consolidation, Resume Trading
fields.The QT includes the following: - Pursuant to a transaction agreement dated May 29, 2026, as amended August 26, 2026, September 25, 2026 and October 1, 2026, the Company has acquired all the outstanding securities of TruSilver Metals Corp. ("TS"). - The Company issued an aggregate of 28,188,497 common shares to the previous shareholders of TS, excluding the common shares issued under the private placement described below. - The Company proceeded with a name change and a consolidation as further described below. For further information, please refer to the Company's Filing Statement dated October 15, 2026 and to the Company's news releases dated April 29, 2026, June 1, 2026, September 15, 2026, October 9, 2026, October 15, 2026 and October 23, 2026. Private Placement - Non-Brokered Prior to the completion of the QT, TS completed a private placement of hard cash and flow-through subscription receipts as well as hard cash and flow-through units resulting in the issuance of the following securities in the Resulting Issuer.
fields.Offering: 9,551,440 Listed Shares with 9,551,440 warrants and 1,474,100 flow-through Listed Shares
fields.Offering Price: $0.25 per Listed Share $0.30 per flow-through Listed Share
fields.Warrant Exercise Terms: $0.45 per Listed Share for a 24-month period
fields.Commission in securities: an aggregate of 269,430 non-transferable broker warrants exercisable at $0.25 for a 24-month period
fields.Disclosure: Refer to the Company's news releases dated September 15, 2026 and October 9, 2026. Name Change and Consolidation Following a resolution of directors passed on October 14, 2026, the Company has consolidated its capital on the basis of 2.5 old shares for 1 new share and changed its name from Galaxy Ventures Inc. to TruSilver Metals Corp. Effective at the opening on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the common shares of TruSilver Metals Corp. will commence trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on a consolidated basis, and the common shares of Galaxy Ventures Inc. will be delisted. Resume Trading Further to the bulletin dated April 28, 2026, effective at the opening on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the common shares of TruSilver Metals Corp. will commence trading on the TSX Venture Exchange (on a consolidated basis) under the symbol "TAG", and the common shares of Galaxy Ventures Inc. (GXY.P) will be delisted. Post-Consolidation and Post-Transactional
